description: Bounded Planner -> DSH Codex Executor -> Reviewer loop with Bridge attachments and auditable artifacts.

userStories.title: Create bounded artifact manifests and project packages
userStories.description: Generate run-scoped ZIP and JSON/Markdown artifacts under a safe local root with canonical-path, byte-limit, hash, and provenance checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Each artifact has runId, stage, name, mime, bytes, sha256, and source.
Symlink escape and oversized artifacts are rejected.
Packaging never writes into or cleans the product repository.

userStories.title: Implement the fixed bounded state machine
userStories.description: Route Planner, approval, execution, evidence, and Reviewer phases through explicit states and one automatic NEEDS_FIX budget.
acceptanceCriteria: ACCEPTED, NEEDS_FIX, NEEDS_REPLAN, DEFER, and ESCALATE route deterministically.
A second automatic NEEDS_FIX cannot execute.

userStories.title: Connect DSH Codex subscription execution
userStories.description: Historical first-phase route: drive an Executor Agent through the installed dsh-codex-subscription openai-codex route using gpt-5.6-luna and the then-approved danger-full-access preset. The danger-full-access permission requirement is superseded for current runtime defaults by the DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 compatibility change: workspace-write with native approval: ask; only trusted host/profile configuration can select a higher preset.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter uses the DSH Agent/LLM runtime rather than a second shell or ChatGPT execution plane.
The executor cwd is the configured product repository.
Executor output, cancellation, and failure become reportable evidence.

userStories.title: Add Bridge attachment transport
userStories.description: Extend DSH-Brain-Bridge CDP worker transport to select allowlisted local artifacts, wait for visible upload completion, send one prompt, and recover idempotently.
acceptanceCriteria: DOM.setFileInputFiles is used only after local manifest and hash validation.
The prompt is not sent while any attachment is uploading.
Retry, timeout, page refresh, and worker restart have explicit outcomes without duplicate submission.

userStories.title: Validate the deterministic first-phase loop
userStories.description: Add fake Bridge, fake DSH Executor, CDP mock, and evidence tests; isolate any real smoke behind an explicit bounded command.
acceptanceCriteria: Fixture marker round trips through Planner and Reviewer fake transport.
Report, diff, and latest project ZIP are attached in Reviewer order.
Default tests use no production account or Codex quota.
